event_summary: Small white and blue balls move along a red tabletop toy track while the track, supports, and surrounding tabletop objects stay in place.
raw_event_description: The video shows a red toy track structure on a wooden table, supported by white columns with yellow tops and black circular bases. At first the setup is visible without an obvious moving ball. A small white ball later appears on the right-side track near a yellow-topped support, moves downward along the right-side curved track area, then is seen on the front lower track moving leftward across the table view in front of a calculator. Other white ball appearances occur on upper and middle red track segments, moving from right-to-left or across the frame. Near the end, a blue ball appears on the lower-left curved part of the track, while a white ball is again visible on the right-side track section. The surrounding calculator, remote control, silver rectangular object, chairs, table, and supports remain visually stationary.

reasons: The red track layout and support columns are clearly visible.
No moving ball is apparent in the first frame.
The tabletop and surrounding objects are visible enough to establish the scene.
